headlines.description: Chelsea slumped to a third-successive Premier League defeat as they went down 3-2 at Nottingham Forest on Friday to mount pressure on boss Xavi Alonso.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jesus stunner helps Forest dump Chelsea for another big home win

headlines.description: Sean Longstaff scored twice and created another as Leeds beat Coventry 3-0 at Elland Road to seal a third successive top-flight win for the first time in five years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sean Longstaff hits double as Leeds stroll to victory over Coventry

headlines.description: Mauricio Pochettino's painful start to life at the Manchester United helm continued as Brentford romped to their first Old Trafford victory since 1937.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brentford pummel Manchester United to hand Mauricio Pochettino nightmare Old Trafford debut
